determinism_fix: all pretrained GPT-2 dropout modules set to p=0 before warm start
determinism_gate: fixed-state and restored-state response repeat errors <= 1e-12
acceptance_gate: every arm-budget record accepts at least one step and zero-step fraction < 0.95
promotion_rule: at both budgets, positive median source-minus-current and budgeted-AdamW-minus-current loss with current dual-winning at least two of three seeds
claim_policy: three-seed development only; a positive result freezes but does not confirm R13
